assumptions.description: Generate exactly 375 individuals per female=0/1 crossed with 25-39,40-54,55-69,70-79. Integer age is uniform within each stratum. Equal stratum sampling is analytical design, not Mexican population prevalence. No individual observations are input.

Independent standardized beta factors: U from Beta(2,5) for right-skew BMI, V from Beta(2,2) for glucose residual; independent standardized Uniform(-sqrt(3),sqrt(3)) W for HbA1c residual. Distribution shapes and their finite supports are completion assumptions, not measured physiological cutoffs.

BMI and fasting glucose have residual Pearson correlation rho=0.30 by assumption. They are independent of age and binary sex in both declared source contexts and the target law. HbA1c has no extra binary-sex term. These unreported covariances/zero coefficients are assumptions, not source findings. They materially affect the fully conditioned BMI projection.

Transport Jansen BMI/glucose means, SDs and separate age/sex-adjusted projections, and Pani fully adjusted age slope, as a single illustrative conditional law. Serum/plasma, assay, country, ancestry, fasting window and source-selection transfer are unverified. This is not an estimator of a recovered Mexican joint distribution.

The law is specified directly for people satisfying the full task eligibility description. Unrecorded diagnosis, fast duration, measurement documentation, pregnancy/lactation routing, anemia and medication variables are not fabricated. Glucose positivity and <126 are guaranteed by the assumed support; no rejection/clipping or subsequent selection is used. Prior diagnosis and measurement validity are membership assumptions and not verifiable from output columns.

Declared already-selected Lifelines source law: independent age=55.5+9.9*standardized Beta(2,2), female Bernoulli(0.597), and the common B,G,H equations. Age is continuous only in this analytic source context. Table1 moments are assumed applicable to Table2 rows although row-specific n is unknown. This is an assumed source context, not source reconstruction.

Declared already-selected Pani source law for qualified analytic checks: equal mass over the eight admitted age bands; uniform integer age within each finite band and age=70+K in the open band, K geometric failures with p=0.1, support 0,1,... . Female Bernoulli(0.5); B,G and residual laws are the same conditional equation. Band weights, within-band age distribution, open-band tail and population intercept transfer from Jansen are assumptions. No target age79 cap is imposed on this source context. Original survey design and weighted covariate distributions remain unavailable.

All evidence point estimates and structural assumptions are fixed for this candidate. Individual residual SD is separated from source-estimate uncertainty, unknown structural dependence and transport. Jansen CI confidence level is absent; no SE is inferred. Pani age-band SEs remain estimator uncertainty, never individual SDs. Repeated seeds are Monte Carlo variability only, not new evidence.

Use directly reported Jansen percent HbA1c mean5.6 and SD0.3. IFCC-derived5.62824 and0.27444 are alternative rounded representations and not additional constraints. Glucose moments use the admitted factor18; slopes use NGSP scale only without affine offset.

Target-table-to-source comparisons are unavailable because no source replay is allocated. All feedback recipes therefore use null operators and not_computable status. Separate deterministic source-law projections are assumption-qualified and do not reconstruct the survey or verify target validity.

design.derivation: Task prescribes sex/age quota and row count; within-band uniform law is assumed.

factor_distributions.derivation: Chosen bounded factors with exact zero mean and unit variance after analytic standardization.

bmi_location_scale.derivation: Admitted mean and individual SD in kg/m^2.

glucose_location_scale.derivation: Admitted 5.1*18=91.8 and0.5*18=9.0 in mg/dL, counted once.

bmi_glucose_rho.derivation: rho=0.30 is an explicit positive moderate dependence scenario; absent joint data do not identify it.

hba1c_reference.derivation: Use direct percent moments once. HbA1c conditional location is centered at source age55.5.

age_slope.derivation: Fully adjusted source slope0.01 percentage points/year, a separate source projection; transported conditionally under the common equation.

female_slope.derivation: Zero additional conditional sex effect is not measured; it is a completion assumption.

separate_source_slopes.derivation: Separate age/sex-adjusted projections:0.13*0.09148 and2.29*0.09148/18, no affine offset.

lifelines_context.derivation: Mean/SD and sex proportion from Jansen; source age shape and independence are assumed.

pani_context.derivation: Explicit source-context completion only. Equal band masses do not use unweighted source n as population weights; open band is uncapped geometric.

joint_hba1c_slopes.derivation: Solve [[sB^2,rho*sB*sG],[rho*sB*sG,sG^2]] beta = [slope_B*sB^2,slope_G*sG^2]. Actual calculation is retained in analytic_calculations.py/results.

hba1c_residual_sd.derivation: sqrt(0.3^2 - age_slope^2*9.9^2 - beta.T*Sigma_BG*beta); fixed residual individual SD. Positive radicand checked analytically.
